display.purpose: Page titles, the single H1 per view. Never a marketing-scale hero.

body.purpose: All running text, held to a 65-75ch measure.

label.purpose: Form labels, table headers, chips, status badges.

shadows.name: soft
shadows.purpose: Default raised surface: cards and panels at rest.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Higher elevation: popovers, dialogs, hovered cards.

shadows.name: hairline-ring
shadows.purpose: Near-invisible edge so white-on-white surfaces do not dissolve.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Forest-green focus indicator at 2px offset; never removed.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default 150ms easing for state transitions (color, border, shadow).

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Button press feedback, scale to 0.97 on :active.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation/transition collapses; motion never required to understand state.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-emphasis action per view. Label is verb + object in plain Thai.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: Sarabun, 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #ffffff; background: #006633; border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #004d27; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #006633; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action. Everything that is not the one primary action is secondary or ghost.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: Sarabun, 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #006633; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d4ddd9; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e6f5ec; border-color: #006633; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #006633; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card

narrative.overview: This is the digital counter of a Thai government certification authority, not a product launch. Official: it issues legally valid GACP certificates under ISO/IEC 17065, so it carries the calm authority of a public register. Green: the literal subject is Thai medicinal herbs, and the deep forest green (#006633) is the one saturated voice on an otherwise quiet page. Register: the interface exists to make a long, multi-hand process legible to a farmer on a cheap phone and to the officer reviewing them. The aim is gov.uk's plain-spoken legibility and the credibility of the ทางรัฐ / ThaID apps. It rejects the generic AI/SaaS dashboard look, the cluttered legacy government page, and the dark fintech aesthetic.
keyCharacteristics: One saturated voice (forest green), everything else quiet neutral.
One typeface (Sarabun), hierarchy by weight and size, never by decoration.
Flat surfaces, hairline separation, motion only to convey state.
Every status is shown by color AND by text/icon — never color alone.
Designed for the worst device and the least confident user first.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Forest green is the only saturated color on a working screen, and it covers <=10% of it. Gold is for official artifacts, never for a second button.

rules.name: The No-Cream Rule
rules.body: The background is Paper White (#f4f6f5), a cool green-tinted near-white. It must not drift toward cream, sand, or beige. #f5efe6 is a document-paper color only, never an app background.

rules.name: The No-Tracking-On-Thai Rule
rules.body: Never apply positive letter-spacing to Thai text — it breaks vowel and tone-mark positioning. Tracking is permitted only on short uppercase Latin labels.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Face Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is built from Sarabun's weights and sizes alone. A second display or premium font is prohibited.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow appears only as a response to state and lifts at most 2px.

rules.name: The No-Glass Rule
rules.body: Glassmorphism is forbidden: no backdrop-filter: blur(), no frosted translucent panels, no glow. Opaque surfaces only.

dos: Do keep Forest Green (#006633) as the single saturated voice, <=10% of any screen.
Do build all hierarchy from Sarabun's weight and size — one family only.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest; reserve the Soft/Card shadows for elevation and hover, lifting at most 2px.
Do pair every status color with a word and/or icon (WCAG 1.4.1).
Do design the mobile, slow-connection, low-literacy path first: visible labels, >=44px targets, plain Thai, recoverable errors.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion; keep product motion to 150-250ms and only to convey state.
Do hold body prose to a 65-75ch measure.
donts: Don't use glassmorphism — no backdrop-filter: blur(), no frosted translucent panels, no glow.
Don't reach for the generic AI/SaaS dashboard look: purple-blue gradients, gradient text, hero-metric tiles, or grids of identical cards.
Don't let the background drift to cream, sand, or beige; the app field is cool Paper White #f4f6f5.
Don't nest a card inside a card, or separate content with a colored side-stripe border thicker than 1px.
Don't add positive letter-spacing to Thai text — it breaks the script.
Don't introduce a second/premium/display font, or the dead Mantine legacy palette.
Don't ship the cluttered-legacy-gov look or the dark fintech/crypto look.
Don't run infinite decorative animation (pulsing badges, perpetual shimmer) on a working screen.
